# Insight Gaps Bureau

Insight Gaps Bureau produces high-trust, evidence-first forensic reporting
from Dhaka, Bangladesh. Every claim is traceable to a published source, or
marked untraced. Corrections are shown dated on the affected story and in
the corrections log. Reporting is licensed CC BY 4.0 for human reuse;
machine-training use is not granted by default (see robots.txt).

## Central pages

* Website Homepage: https://www.insightgaps.com
* Investigations Index: https://www.insightgaps.com/investigations/
* Archive: https://www.insightgaps.com/archive/
* Evidence and Data: https://www.insightgaps.com/evidence/
* Methodology and Trust: https://www.insightgaps.com/methodology/
* Corrections Log: https://www.insightgaps.com/corrections/
* About: https://www.insightgaps.com/about/
* Contact: https://www.insightgaps.com/contact/
* Sitemap: https://www.insightgaps.com/sitemap.xml

## Accountability investigations

### BD-INV-001: Blood Routes
* URL: https://www.insightgaps.com/investigations/blood-routes/
* Published: 2026-05-26. Revised: 2026-09-03.
* Summary: Bangladesh road deaths at six times the official count. WHO
  modelled deaths about 31,578 per year versus the BRTA official count of
  5,480 per year (ratio about 5.8x, a definition gap, not a rounding
  difference). 351 people died in 15 days during the 2026 Eid-ul-Fitr rush.
  The joma daily-lease contract forces bus drivers to race for passengers.
  Four government-held datasets are not published. Claims: 7 (R-01 to R-07).
  Corrections on the page: C-001, C-002.
* Claim register: https://www.insightgaps.com/claims/BD-INV-001.json
* Dataset: https://www.insightgaps.com/data/BD-INV-001.csv
* Evidence appendix: https://www.insightgaps.com/investigations/blood-routes/evidence/

### BD-INV-002: The Impunity Machine
* URL: https://www.insightgaps.com/investigations/the-impunity-machine/
* Published: 2026-03-01. Revised: 2026-09-03.
* Summary: Bangladesh rape-justice outcomes measured as conviction rates
  from 0.12% to 3.66% depending on the denominator used — the denominator
  is the finding. DNA backlog: 1,204 of 1,304 samples. Court filings
  17,544 versus disposals 5,648 in the reported year. Aggregate data only;
  no case-level data is published. Claims: 8 (R-01 to R-08).
  Corrections on the page: C-003, C-004.
* Claim register: https://www.insightgaps.com/claims/BD-INV-002.json
* Dataset: https://www.insightgaps.com/data/BD-INV-002.csv
* Evidence appendix: https://www.insightgaps.com/investigations/the-impunity-machine/evidence/

### BD-INV-003: The Lead Belt
* URL: https://www.insightgaps.com/investigations/the-lead-belt/
* Published: 2026-05-25. Revised: 2026-09-03.
* Summary: Bangladesh lead poisoning mapped: 294 contaminated sites,
  145 schools within 500 metres, soil lead readings up to 1,702 times the
  international safety standard. Satellite evidence is described as
  satellite corroboration, never satellite proof. Claims: 8 (R-01 to R-08).
  Correction on the page: C-005.
* Claim register: https://www.insightgaps.com/claims/BD-INV-003.json
* Dataset: https://www.insightgaps.com/data/BD-INV-003.csv
* Evidence appendix: https://www.insightgaps.com/investigations/the-lead-belt/evidence/

## Exclusions
* Internal, staging, unlinked, and in-progress documents are completely excluded.
